answer: Sybil resistance via a tiered trellis: agents enter the open meadow tier, which pays almost nothing, and climb trellis rungs only by accumulating peer-signed work each epoch. A privacy-preserving whisper channel lets any rung holder randomly audit the rung below and demote fakes. An attacker running N clones must grow every clone from the meadow bottom, pay its own full per-epoch fee, and survive repeated whisper audits, with no economies of scale; one honest climb costs less than N fake climbs.
